executiveSummary: Brawlhalla: 700 Steam reviews analyzed for live-ops decision support (operations intelligence, not sentiment ratio reporting).
Priority #1: Balance & Combat Fairness — 41 mentions, critical impact, medium business risk.
Secondary focus: Matchmaking & Ranked Integrity (40 mentions, critical impact).
Preserve strengths players explicitly praise: Casual Fun & Entertainment, Free Access & Perceived Value, Character/Mode Variety.
Recommended operating posture: ship network/matchmaking telemetry first, then monetization clarity, then content cadence communication.
Risk if unaddressed: elevated churn in ranked segments and rising store-review backlash in priority language regions.
Next 30-day KPI focus: disconnect rate, ranked queue fairness, new-player D7 retention, and monetization-related negative review velocity.
